title.narrative: Area-Based-Allocations: Integrated lifesaving Health, Nutrition and WASH support to vulnerable crises affected populations in Kass, Gorlongbang and Kirigneer areas in South Darfur State.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project objective is to provide integrated lifesaving WASH, Nutrition and Health services to approximatelynbsp222,600 conflict affected people including host communities, returnees and IDPs over 8 months in Kass and South Jabal Mara localities of South Darfur State. The project have been designed to address and meet the full set of WASH needs that can be appropriately implemented in each community, with particular attention to the specific WASH needs of women and girls though repair of boreholes/hand pumps and piped network system, install solar-powered pumps, chlorinate water systems, install water storage facilities, conduct environmental cleaning campaigns, and rehabilitate and improve basic sanitation infrastructure (household and emergency latrines) access to maternal health care services and strengthened child health services.lt/pgtltpgtUnder this project, CARE will booster and increase the capacity of the health and nutrition services in the 4 health centers that are under CARE’s support (Gorlongban,nbspFeina,nbspKirigneernbspandnbspGabra) the communities in the surrounding areas, innbsp Gorlongbannbspand in Kirigneernbsparea to meet the increased needs in Health and Nutrition of the recently arrived displaced population in the area and the host communities. For Health, the project will support and scale up the delivery of the essential primary health care services, includingnbspconsultations for communicational and non-communicable diseases, while considerable attention to scale up the maternal and child health needs and services will be given through IMCI consultations, antenatal care and postnatal care and supporting deliveries with skilled birth attendants. The project will provide additional capacity building to the midwives to ensure good quality of services, in addition to GBV and CMR to ensure provision of support to and referral for care to GBV survivors. The project will support the provision of medical supplies, complementing what is provided from WHO to these 4 centers under other grants. In addition, the project will provide clean delivery kits and baby kits, IPC materials and IEC materials. ltbrgtThe project will scale up the nutrition preventive and treatment services, through conducting MUAC screening to identify malnourished children and PLW and refer them to the supported OTPs and TSFPs by CARE. MoH staff at the OTPs and TSFP will receive capacity building in CMAM protocol. Supplies to the OTPs and TSFPs will be coordinated with UNICEF and WFP. In addition, the project will support the referral of the SAM with medical complications to get treatment at the SC. The project will scale up the dissemination of IYCE to the displaced population and the host community through campaigns.lt/pgtltpgtCARE Team in South Darfur office and country office will be supporting the coordination to support the implementation of the planned activities, and to ensure the coordination with the UNs to facilitatenbspthe supplies and access. nbsp ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
